messages:
Sam (PS): Hey team — Acme POC hitting 429s during burst tests. They hit ~120 reqs/s for ~30s and started getting 429s with Retry-After: 15.
Maria (AE): Ack, when did this start? Are they using embeddings or completions?
Sam (PS): Completions + streaming. Logs show lots of short requests. Example response headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 15
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1700000000
```
Alex (Eng): That's per-tenant burst window hitting the per-route cap. Do we have their route configured as 'chat.completions' or custom route? If default, per-route cap applies.
Jen (Support): Opened ticket #SUP-4321 and requested temporary cap bump. Also recommended they add exponential backoff with jitter client-side.
Sam (PS): Any config we can change server-side short term? They need the POC to run tests tomorrow.
Alex (Eng): Short term options:
- Increase burst_tokens for their tenant (e.g., from 50 -> 200)
- Add a per-tenant override for route `chat.completions`
- Enable prefix caching for repeated prompts to reduce tokens
I can push a temp override — will need approval from infra.
Maria (AE): Also they're worried about cost if we lift caps. Can we set a soft quota + alerts?
Alex (Eng): Yes: set daily token budget 500k and hard stop at 600k. We can also set notifications at 70/90%.
Sam (PS): Could you share the API call to change burst tokens? I want to show the customer.
Alex (Eng): Example admin API call:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/acme/limits \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"route":"chat.completions","burst_tokens":200,"daily_budget_tokens":500000}'
```
Maria (AE): :thumbsup: If infra approves we'll do it for a 48h window.
RatecapBot: Tenant acme: current window usage 85% — noticed spikes at 11:17:43 UTC. Suggested action: enable client-side smoothing.
Jen (Support): I've requested infra approval. If denied, we can stagger their test runs and implement client retries + backoff today.
Sam (PS): Thanks. I'll tell the customer we might have a 48h bump or they can reduce concurrency. Also asked them to add `X-Custom-Client-Id` header to help correlate.
Alex (Eng): One more note: streaming increases the number of small requests — recommend batching prompts where possible.
Maria (AE): I'll coordinate with Acme to change test schedule if needed.
Jen (Support): SUP-4321 updated with proposed limits and cost estimate.
Sam (PS): Great — please ping here when infra approves so I can confirm with them. :pray:
